title: Coupled Predictor-Corrector Host Contract

canonical_reconciliation.head: f2d472cb0e4d935ef39f002d6f21c8d90acf4dd8
canonical_reconciliation.delta_from_f_gc36_reconciliation: 9 commits, only PUB-P2E10 publication workflow, documentation and publication tests; no F-GC30 through F-GC36 dependency source changed.

blocking_discovery.fact: xmipy/MODFLOW6 exposes forward solve lifecycle but no native checkpoint/rollback/restore equivalent to the SWAP transaction contract.
blocking_discovery.consequence: A live in-place MODFLOW kernel cannot yet be claimed to generate repeated same-origin candidates.
blocking_discovery.decision: F-GC37 qualifies only the transaction-capable host contract. Live MODFLOW origin restoration is a separate backend workunit.

qualified_iteration_contract.predictor: built exactly once from accepted SWAP origin
qualified_iteration_contract.candidate_rule: both non-converged candidates discarded before the next iteration
qualified_iteration_contract.bounded_failure: max iterations -> NOT_CONVERGED, request smaller window, no commit

publication_contract: preflight SWAP candidate plus prepared groundwater plus prepared ledger

failed_iteration.head: e113a124d0f028eda24e05f4d55c0b07039e0117
failed_iteration.disposition: Static test used a raw substring ban and rejected a docstring mentioning xmipy. The ownership gate was changed to syntax-aware import/call inspection only. Production host code and orchestration logic were unchanged.

not_yet_qualified: live repeated MODFLOW candidates from one groundwater origin
real SWAP5 plus live MODFLOW end-to-end outer iteration

next_permitted_action: Open a separately bounded MODFLOW6 transactional-origin backend workunit. Prove repeated live candidate solves start from the same accepted groundwater origin before connecting that backend to the qualified F-GC37 host.
